title: Suppress zero-value rows in Trial Balance by Period
summary: The Trial Balance by Period Excel report now suppresses rows with zero values by default and adds an optional request-page parameter to include them when needed.
key_points: Added a Show Lines with Zero Values request-page option that is disabled by default
Fixed the report to exclude zero-value dimension combinations unless explicitly requested
Reduces workbook size by eliminating irrelevant rows from dimension combinations
Users can still access the complete set of dimension combinations when needed
Added regression test coverage for both suppressed and included zero-value scenarios
quote: The report should support that behavior explicitly without making it the default.
